maddeler.e:
نستلف (form VIII)
# نَسْتَلِفُ (nastalifu) /nas.ta.li.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# نُسْتَلَفُ (nustalafu) /nus.ta.la.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# نَسْتَلِفَ (nastalifa) /nas.ta.li.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# نُسْتَلَفَ (nustalafa) /nus.ta.la.fa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
